name: support-faq
description: Customer-support FAQ assistant evaluation set (deterministic demo).

expected.answer: You can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase with your order number.

input.question: How do I reset my password?

expected.answer: Open the login page, click Forgot password, and follow the email link we send you.

input.question: How can I delete my account?

expected.answer: Go to Settings, choose Privacy, then Delete account. Deletion is permanent after 7 days.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping arrives in 1 to 2 business days.

input.question: How do I cancel my subscription?

expected.answer: Open Billing, select your plan, and click Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the billing period.
Email support@example.com or use in-app chat Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern.

input.question: How do I update my payment method?

expected.answer: Go to Billing, choose Payment methods, then Add or replace your card. Changes apply to the next invoice.
Open Orders, select your order, and view the tracking link once the package has shipped.

input.question: Can I change the email on my account?

expected.answer: Yes. Open Settings, edit Email, confirm the new address from the verification message we send.

input.question: How do I get a return shipping label?

expected.answer: Start a return from Orders, choose the items, and download the prepaid label we generate for eligible products.
